dedupe_keys.name: public awareness of and attitudes towards electric cars

description: Public Awareness of and Attitudes Towards Electric Cars is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Regional Development. This publication has been produced by Central Statistics and Research Branch (CSRB). It contains information on people’s awareness of and attitudes towards electric cars and the factors that would encourage or discourage them from buying an electric vehicle. Coverage: Department for Regional Development. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Regional Development. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
